1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. The present petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.PC seeking quashing of the Fir
No.0029/2016 under Sections 498A/406/34 Ipc registered at Ps Badarpur, South-East Delhi on
the ground that the parties have entered into a settlement.

Learned APP for the State accepts notice and submits that since the parties have entered into a settlement, the State has no objection, in case, the FIR in question is quashed.
4.
Respondent no.2, who appears through video conferencing along with her counsel accepts notice.
